'''Arick Tamso''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] living on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]] along with his brother [[Pol Tamso|Pol]]. During the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]] Arick worked along with fellow doctor [[Tabo]] on pacifying the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] at the [[Sundari Research Grounds]] facility. However, Tabo hoped to use the Colicoids as a weapons and sabotaged the experiments by tampering the suppressive implants and causing the Colicoids to break free, killing the staff. Tabo sealed Arick Tamso and the other survivors in and fled to safety, though before his death Arick managed to make a holorecording that proved Tabo's guilt.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arick Tamso appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a hologram during a Heroic quest "Colicoid Massacre."
